title: Avoid!
text:
Avoid!. The first slow cooker I received was obviously damaged. It was returned.

The second slow cooker I received didn't have a working indicator light. By the way it was packaged, it had been previously returned.

Doesn't Proctor Silex have any quality control checks?

Why is Amazon reselling defective items?

product_metadata.title: Proctor Silex 33015Y 1-1/2-Quart Round Slow Cooker
features: The product is manufactured in China
The product is easy to use
description: Enjoy healthy, home-cooked meals even with a busy schedule thanks to this easy-to-use round-shaped slow cooker. With its 1-1/2-quart capacity, the unit works great for cooking up small batches of soup, casseroles, warm dips, sauces, and more. Simply add ingredients to its stoneware crock, insert the crock into the cooker, and turn the temperature-control dial from off to keep warm, low, or high. Equipped with a tall, cool-touch knob, the slow cooker's clear tempered-glass lid traps in heat and moisture and allows for checking on food at a glance. Even more, the removable crock doubles as a serving dish and can go straight from the table to the refrigerator to store leftovers with quick convenience. Integrated handles on the crock make it easy to lift and carry, even when wearing oven mitts, while stay-cool side handles on the cooker ensure safe, comfortable transport from home to picnics or potlucks and back again. The slow cooker measures approximately 8 by 8 by 9 inches, and the removable crock and glass lid clean up easily by hand or in the dishwasher.
